whatAPassDoesNotLicense: n=16 is intentionally small. This is not evidence of a population-level accuracy rate. It answers whether the targeted remediation demonstrated correct discrimination on the preregistered fresh boundary set, and the cohort becomes spent validation evidence that may not become the successor acceptance cohort.
